Dress-Up, Doll Maker & Fashion Runway.loreTemplate: You are the rising lead stylist at an elite international fashion atelier. High-profile clients arrive with urgent event briefs—from Velvet Gothic Galas to Cyber-Idol Debuts—and only your eye for silhouette, fabric texture, and color harmony can win the Gold Crown on the main runway.
Dress-Up, Doll Maker & Fashion Runway.objective: Curate a cohesive multi-layer look across hair, tops, bottoms/gowns, shoes, and accessories that matches the client's theme brief, hits the required Style Synergy score, and unlocks rare couture swatches in your Lookbook.
howItWorks: 1. Read the Client Brief & Theme Tags: Check the target dress code (e.g., Romantic Baroque, Streetwear Pop, Royal Gala) and bonus color harmony goals.
2. Layer & Customize Garments: Select categories (Hair Back/Bangs, Dress/Top/Bottom, Hosiery, Footwear, Jewelry, Props) and apply live color/pattern swatches.
3. Walk the Runway & Save to Lookbook: Trigger the Runway Evaluation to receive itemized scores on Theme Match, Color Harmony, and Accessory Balance, unlocking new boutique tiers.

Makeover Salon, Hair Physics & Room Deco.objective: Complete the tactile treatment steps (wash, precision cut/curl, multi-tone dye, skincare/glam, or isometric furniture placement) with high precision before the Before/After photo reveal.

Culinary Prep, Mixology & Kitchen Statio.targetAudience: Foodies, Precision Timing Fans & Cozy Kitchen Creators

Culinary Prep, Mixology & Kitchen Statio.loreTemplate: The head chef just walked out five minutes before the festival rush, leaving you in charge of the boardwalk's flagship Kitchen & Mixology Bar. Ticket orders are clipping onto the rail, the grill is sizzling, and the town's toughest food critics are walking through the door.
Culinary Prep, Mixology & Kitchen Statio.objective: Execute each customer ticket across the Order, Prep/Pour, Cook/Shake, and Build/Garnish stations to earn 90%+ Critic Ratings, huge tips, and Golden Recipe badges.
howItWorks: 1. Take & Read the Ticket: Pin the customer's exact order ratios, doneness target, and garnish placement to the ticket rail.
2. Precision Prep & Cook/Mix: Slice/pour to the fill lines, flip or shake when the thermal/mix meter hits the sweet spot, and avoid burning or over-pouring.
3. Artful Plating & Critic Reveal: Layer toppings symmetrically and serve to watch the customer's expressive reaction and score breakdown.

Cozy Diner, Boutique & Resort Time-Manag.loreTemplate: To save your family's beloved waterfront venue from a greedy developer buyout, you must turn a sleepy two-table cafe into a five-star culinary landmark—chaining service combos, keeping every guest smiling, and reinvesting tips into dazzling upgrades.
Cozy Diner, Boutique & Resort Time-Manag.objective: Hit the daily Cash Target before closing time by seating guests on matching color-bonus booths, chaining consecutive actions (Order -> Serve -> Check -> Clean), and upgrading your venue between shifts.
howItWorks: 1. Seat & Color-Match Guests: Drag arriving party groups to matching-color tables to stack Seat Color Multipliers.
2. Queue Chained Actions: Click tables in sequence so your host performs 3-4 consecutive Orders or Deliveries in a single sprint for Combo bonuses.
3. Upgrade Your Venue: Spend daily tips on faster Roller Skates, Jukeboxes (patience boosters), Chef Speed, and Plush VIP Booths.

Music Sequencer, Band Stage & Falling-Sa.objective: Arrange synchronized rhythm/melody loops or elemental chain reactions to hit the Stage Hype & Harmony targets, unlocking secret Chorus Breakdowns and Master Producer badges.

2. Trigger Live Solos & Chain Reactions: Mute, solo, or ignite combos on the downbeat to build the Crowd Hype multiplier.

exemplars: Burrito Bison & Burrito Bison Revenge (Juicy Beast)
Distance Launcher & Upgrade Shop.loreTemplate: Mocked by the Academy for claiming your makeshift contraption could cross the Great Continental Divide, you have built a ramp, strapped on a prototype booster, and opened your blueprint workshop. Every meter flown funds stronger hulls, bouncier ground-slams, and orbital rockets.
Distance Launcher & Upgrade Shop.objective: Launch from the ramp, chain mid-air boosts and ground-slam bounces to maintain momentum, spend cash in the 5-tier Workshop between flights, and smash through the Final Barrier Wall.
howItWorks: 1. Lock Launch Angle & Power: Time the oscillating launch gauge for maximum initial velocity off the ramp.
2. Control Pitch, Glide & Slam: Tilt in mid-air for aerodynamic lift, fire rocket fuel at apexes, and trigger ground-slams on springy targets to regain speed.
3. Upgrade in the Workshop: Spend flight cash after every run on Ramp Height, Glider Aerodynamics, Rocket Thrusters, and Bouncer Multipliers.

As Supreme Marshal, you must balance gold harvesting, frontline infantry, ranged support, and era-advancing research—calling down cataclysmic commander abilities to shatter the enemy stronghold.
Lane Siege & Tug-of-War Generals.objective: Reduce the enemy Citadel's HP from 100% to 0% by spawning counter-unit waves, upgrading base turrets, and advancing through Technological Eras before the rival general overwhelms your gates.
howItWorks: 1. Balance Economy & Spawns: Spend Gold/Mana to queue Melee Vanguards, Ranged Archers/Gunners, and Heavy Siege Engines down the lane.
2. Counter the Enemy Formation: Read incoming enemy unit compositions (Armored vs. Anti-Armor, Swarm vs. Splash) and time your deployments.
3. Evolve Eras & Unleash Specials: Spend XP to evolve your Citadel into the next Era and trigger screen-shaking Commander Ultimates.

Wave-Defense Tower Micro-Strategy.loreTemplate: Raiders are marching along the winding pass toward your Sanctuary Core. As Master Engineer, you command the tactical defense grid—placing specialized towers on strategic choke points, routing power polarities, and calling waves early to earn bonus interest.
Wave-Defense Tower Micro-Strategy.objective: Prevent invaders from breaching your Sanctuary Core across all waves by placing, upgrading, and cross-synergizing towers while timing active tactical skills.
howItWorks: 1. Place Chokepoint Towers: Build Kinetic, Splash, Slow/Tether, and Amplifier towers along path bends for maximum coverage.
2. Trigger Twist Synergies: Switch tower polarity or link tethers between pylons to multiply damage against armored formations.
3. Call Waves Early & Upgrade: Send the next wave early for bonus gold interest and specialize towers into Tier-3 branches.

Physics Destruction & Artillery Siege.pacingType: Survey Structure -> Aim Trajectory & Ammo Type -> Detonate Mid-Flight -> Watch Collapse

palette.styleName: Sunset Siege Diorama, Timber Beams & Masonry Stone

Physics Destruction & Artillery Siege.loreTemplate: Across the disputed borderlands, rival barons have erected timber, iron, and stone fortifications thinking they are untouchable. With a calibrated siege launcher and a limited quiver of specialized payloads, you must bring every fortress crashing down in as few shots as possible.
Physics Destruction & Artillery Siege.objective: Eliminate all garrisoned targets in each fortress within your Par Shot budget by striking load-bearing pillars, TNT crates, and ricochet angles for Gold Medal mastery.
howItWorks: 1. Inspect the Structure: Identify fragile timber joints, heavy stone slabs, explosive barrels, and load-bearing keystones.
2. Set Trajectory & Payload: Drag or double-tap to set launch angle/power and select Triple-Cluster, Piercing Iron, or Delayed Bomb ammo.
3. Trigger Mid-Air Secondary Action: Tap mid-flight to split projectiles or detonate shockwaves right at the structural weak point.

Momentum/Grapple Platformer.objective: Chain wall-jumps, slope slides, and grapple swings to collect the Stage Cores and reach the Exit Portal under the Gold Medal par time.

3. Hit the Exit Portal for Medal Times: Collect optional speed-rings to shave seconds off your personal best.

Subterranean Drilling/Mining Roguelite.objective: Drill through destructible soil and rock strata, haul high-value minerals back to the Surface Outpost before your Fuel or Hull hits zero, upgrade your rig, and breach the Ancient Core.
howItWorks: 1. Drill & Navigate Strata: Steer your rig downward or laterally through dirt and ore veins while watching your Fuel Tank and Cargo Weight.
2. Manage Depth Pressure & Hazards: Avoid magma pockets, gas explosions, and subterranean creatures—or use emergency teleporters/thrusters to ascend.
3. Sell Ore & Upgrade at Surface: Cash in your haul at the Surface Outpost to upgrade Drill Bit, Fuel Tank, Cargo Bay, Radiator, and Hull.
